scenes.headline: How LongLive-Plug reuses a video model's speedups
scenes.sub: Distill the speedup once as a LoRA, then plug it into compatible models.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Mabel! Video models get sped up over and over, once for every new version. Here is a way to do that work a single time, and reuse it.

scenes.text: Learn a speedup once as a small adapter on a base model, then plug that same adapter into its many downstream descendants without any retraining.

steps.say: First, learn the speedup once on a frozen base model. It becomes a small, reusable adapter.
Snap that same adapter onto a whole family of models built from that base. No new training.
Then onto two more families. One adapter, dozens of downstream models, each keeping its own weights.

scenes.title: Two ways to get a fast model

left.title: Re-distill each
items: Train a fresh speedup per model
New data and teacher each time
left.say: The usual way trains a new speedup into every model. Fresh data and a teacher, every single time.

right.title: Distill once
right.say: Here, one adapter is learned once and plugged in. The bill stays flat as the models pile up.

scenes.title: Four-step quality on a world model
scenes.note: Video quality score, lower is better; all at four steps.
scenes.say: On one world model, plain four-step video is blurry. The reused adapter scores far better, almost matching a model trained only for that task.

scenes.label: H100 GPU-hours per family, versus 456.8 to re-distill four tasks
scenes.note: reuse the base adapters, no per-target data
scenes.say: And the cost? One family's whole speedup runs about eighty cluster-hours, however many models reuse it. Re-training each instead runs past four hundred.

scenes.text: Distillation stops being baked into one model and becomes an adapter you train once and carry to every compatible descendant.

recap: Distill a capability once on a base model
Plug the adapter into compatible downstream models
Reuse instead of re-distilling per model
scenes.say: To recap: distill once on a base, plug the adapter into compatible models, and stop paying for distillation again and again.
